written_before: W was calibrated and before any controller was instantiated

sensor_coordinate.r: r(d) = 1/2 - d/(2W)  so that higher r means higher risk
sensor_coordinate.outside_policy: OUTSIDE_WINDOW -> conservative fallback action 1.0; never clipped

guard_rule: max safety action of the two adjacent leaves; the central guard containing r=0.5 is therefore conservative

CONTROLLABILITY_GATE.criterion: for at least 90% of D_controller_budget prompts, q_cap * ||h_P0|| * |kappa| >= 2*W*M_3(1/3) = 2W/27
CONTROLLABILITY_GATE.rationale: A controller that cannot move a state by at least its own certified margin cannot enforce the policy that margin certifies. Stating the requirement in units of the Cantor certificate keeps it independent of any particular rho and of any outcome.

budget.target_selection_rule: smallest common q_rms attainable by every rho that produces measurable action, keeps coherence >= 0.95, and stays at or below q_cap
